sql: SELECT id, notes FROM (SELECT sluice_src.id, sluice_src.name, sluice_src.email, sluice_src.ssn, sluice_src.salary, CASE WHEN sluice_src.notes IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN length(sluice_src.notes::varchar) > $1 THEN concat(substr(sluice_src.notes::varchar, 1, $1), $2) ELSE sluice_src.notes::varchar END AS notes FROM pg.hr.employees sluice_src) employees
